alexcrichton opened PR #14971 from alexcrichton:limit-fibers to bytecodealliance:main:

This commit adds a knob to limit the number of active fibers within a store by default. This is set to a relatively small value since wasm today generally doesn't allocate many fibers, and embedders can always raise this limit as desired.
